Decision: Integrate P017 into a computational-support domain, not the independent experimental training pool.
Scientific_Rationale: P017 contains no new physical tensile specimens; all data are MD simulations.
Implementation_Rule: recovery master may retain source/support rows, but independent experimental ML count must not increase.

Decision: Represent 12 distinct computational conditions = 2 alloys × 6 T/strain-rate combinations.
Scientific_Rationale: Table 1 summarizes the total 12 simulated tensile cases.
Implementation_Rule: Create P017_SIM_* IDs; Independent_Computational_Condition=True and Independent_Experimental_ML_sample=False.

Decision: Preserve authors-native TRIP/TWIP separately from experimental targets.
Scientific_Rationale: Mechanism definitions are phase-path specific and include BCC twinning and reversible BCC↔FCC(HCP/SF) transformations.
Implementation_Rule: Do not populate effective experimental TRIP/TWIP from these simulation labels.

Decision: Recover 0 K FCC stable SFE and BCC unstable SFE with strict method/structure provenance.
Scientific_Rationale: The paper reports exact EAM GSFE values for both alloy compositions.
Implementation_Rule: Store -14/-27 as FCC γsf and 610/579 as BCC γusf; never collapse them into one SFE column without subtype.

Decision: Keep only high-value coupled-mechanism landmarks instead of all atomic snapshots.
Scientific_Rationale: Full trajectories are correlated and visually dense; key sequences already capture causal mechanism chronology.
Implementation_Rule: Use supporting correlated simulation records; no master-sample inflation.

Decision: Do not normalize nominal molar-ratio formulas to at.% in this recovery stage.
Scientific_Rationale: Project chemistry standardization is a later controlled step.
Implementation_Rule: Preserve Al0.5CrCoFeCuNi and Al1.5CrCoFeCuNi original molar-ratio basis.

Decision: Do not interpret PTM HCP percentage as experimental martensite fraction.
Scientific_Rationale: HCP local structure is also used to identify stacking faults inside FCC.
Implementation_Rule: Preserve HCP_or_SF scope and explicit phase-path descriptions.
